about.headline: Two Families. One Vision.
about.story: FTS Visions was founded by Szilárd Tóth and András Fodor, driven by a shared conviction: every small business deserves a professional online presence — regardless of budget. As entrepreneurs and developers, we work to turn our clients' digital vision into reality. The name FTS Visions carries the initials of our families, together with the vision we represent. We provide full-service support in Romanian, Hungarian, and English, so we can help your business in whichever language you're most comfortable with.
